title: Birthdays and Months
text:
My birthday is in May. It is on May 15th. We have a big party every year. My friends bring cake and gifts.

Ana's birthday is in June. Her party is on June 3rd. In July we go to the beach. It is hot in July.

questions.text: What can you infer about the narrator's party?
options: It is a party with friends.
It is a party at school.
It is a party in winter.
It is a party with no guests.

questions.text: Why do the people probably go to the beach in July?
options: Because it is hot in July.
Because it is raining in July.
Because it is the first month of the year.

vocabulary.definition: the day each year when a person was born
a social event where people eat, drink and have fun together
an area of sand or stones next to the sea

paragraph_translations: Meu aniversário é em maio. É no dia 15 de maio. Nós fazemos uma grande festa todo ano. Meus amigos trazem bolo e presentes.
O aniversário da Ana é em junho. A festa dela é no dia 3 de junho. Em julho nós vamos à praia. Está quente em julho.
